description: A user's review of a book. StrongRefs the catalog book and optionally the originating bookShelving. rkey: tid. Written by the OAuth client (livtet-service) via com.atproto.repo.putRecord.

book.description: AT-URI of the catalog book record being reviewed.

shelf.description: AT-URI of the originating bookShelving record, if any.

rating.description: Optional 1-10 rating. Half-stars are not yet supported at the lexicon level; round to the nearest integer. Tracked separately as a writer-side concern (see BookReviewRating type in livtet-service).
